title: This will change how people watch sports #shorts
description:
This is gonna change how people watch sports forever.

That shot you’re seeing is not coming from a camera sliding on a track.

It’s not a drone. In fact, there’s no actual camera moving at all.

The visuals are being captured by that little black bar….

It’s a brand new type of weightless camera made specifically for sports.

Now this virtual camera is super different than anything else ever created.

It contains hundreds of AI sensors that stitch together volumetric images of the scene in real-time.

This gives broadcasters the ability to live stream or replay any moment from any angle with zero lag.

And you can get shots that just weren’t ever possible before.

The company that made this is a Norwegian startup called Muybridge.

And they’re currently using it for tennis, golf, and planning for a bunch of other sports soon.

You can imagine this being placed around the entire Octagon for MMA, down the sidelines for the NFL, or even fully along the entire basketball court in the NBA.

Now the reason this works so well and the big innovation here is that the entire camera system is software based.

So it doesn’t need to be moved, it doesn’t take up a ton of room, and it won’t block fans from the viewing experience.

This company just raised a new round of funding literally yesterday, and are planning to scale this over the next few years.

One thing is super clear, with this type of camera technology, the future of sports is gonna look a whole lot different.
